PHRF-33 remains open/not admitted. Blocked N=1200 preparation, repaired decoding and public output continue to pass the portable low-noise integration scenario. The penalized search now uses a domain envelope-gradient contraction with one value reference: 3 band solves / 13 RHS per B0 call, versus the previous first-order 9/43 and full-jet 21/103. Nine starts, 901-request diagnostic budget, priors and terminal full-jet admission remain unchanged; optional provenance is bounded-multistart/v3. Five alternating paired 64-call probes show 6.97x JVM and 5.44x FastOpt Scala.js ratios against full jets, not against the previous first-order path and not end-to-end workload speedups. Gale pin remains 0a981febc163e539b019aa9379935e21d8987a20.

The 120-second bounded B0 attempt reaches 384/100000 in 126.125s (52 decoder accepted, 266 Boundary, 66 CurvatureNotPositive); all 52 accepted shapes fail the explicit 1e-8 prepared residual gate. N=1200 reaches 18/10000 in 136.570s, all Boundary. No complete block is delivered or coefficient output emitted before cancellation. Attempted numerical work is retained. Preparation is 1.549s / 21.938s. Other JVM activity and uncontrolled long-lived sbt state preclude an end-to-end before/after speed claim. Whole-process heap samples are not engine peak; the source-only shared-plus-eight-search-reference scenario falls to 224.75 MiB, while eight full terminal references still reach 321.04 MiB before excluded scratch/blocks/metadata.

The 192-second N=1200 attempt refuses kernel-compiler training work before trial preparation. Finite observation bounds remain loose and exclude the original pipeline. Complete original-family certification, broader scientific qualification and full B0/stress throughput/live-memory gates are still unmet. FiniteState remains deferred; the repaired 901-request diagnostic is not a silent replacement of the frozen baseline.

Validation: full fit 706 JVM / 648 Scala.js tests pass. All 80 recovery reference cases preserve the prior energy/shape/admission tolerances on both platforms; no bitwise trajectory identity is claimed. The six targeted law suites pass on both platforms (18 JS tests; JVM runs include final two-test horizon suite). Comparison: 466 JVM passed / 10 skipped, 17 targeted Scala.js tests passed. Compiler warning-clean; existing multiple-main discovery message only. No hosted CI, merge or publication. Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-readout-bounds-20261007/README.md on local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007, base e1d67dfb; source/artifact hashes verified. Scientific and epic qualification remain open. Releasing this session claim and reservations.
